title: Onrecord Claim Line
description: One newline-delimited JSON claim object stored in an onrecord JSONL record file.

id.description: Position-bound claim identifier derived from the first 16 hex characters of SHA-256 over Canonical Form 1 of {"claim": <claim-without-id>, "position": <0-based-line-index>}.

text.description: Non-empty statement of the asserted claim.

asserter.description: Non-empty identifier of the agent, service, or operator making the claim.

asserted_at.description: Caller-supplied ISO 8601 timestamp validated by flighttape::timeparse::parse_timestamp.

evidence.description: Non-empty list of supporting evidence receipts.

supersedes.description: ID of the immediate predecessor claim this entry replaces, or null for a root claim.

subject.description: Optional subject key grouping live claims and surfacing conflicts.

due.description: Optional ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the live claim comes due.
